description: This source file contains unit tests for the VoiceWakeRuntime component, verifying trigger trimming, content detection after trigger, language handling, and gate logic related to wake word commands.

classes.name: VoiceWakeRuntimeTests
classes.description: A collection of unit tests for validating various functionalities of the VoiceWakeRuntime system, including trigger detection, content extraction, language handling, and gating logic.

methods.name: `trims after trigger keeps post speech`
methods.description: Tests that the function correctly trims the speech after a trigger word.

methods.name: `trims after trigger returns original when no trigger`
methods.description: Verifies that if no trigger word is present, the original text is returned unmodified.

methods.name: `trims after first matching trigger`
methods.description: Ensures that trimming occurs correctly after the first trigger in the text.

methods.name: `has content after trigger false when only trigger`
methods.description: Checks that the system correctly identifies no substantive content following only the trigger.

methods.name: `has content after trigger true when speech continues`
methods.description: Validates detection of content present after the trigger word.

methods.name: `trims after chinese trigger keeps post speech`
methods.description: Tests trimming with Chinese trigger words, ensuring language handling works properly.

methods.name: `trims after trigger handles width insensitive forms`
methods.description: Verifies trimming works with full-width character versions of trigger words.

methods.name: `gate requires gap between trigger and command`
methods.description: Tests gate logic to ensure a minimum gap between trigger and command to prevent false triggers.

methods.name: `gate accepts gap and extracts command`
methods.description: Checks that with sufficient gap, the command is correctly extracted.

methods.name: `gate command text handles foreign string ranges`
methods.description: Verifies that the command extraction handles string ranges involving foreign or non-ASCII characters correctly.
